Version 1.0.136 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.136
It has: by-hand bets on proven-losing types are blocked (not just warned), with the NCAAB tab exempt, and proven-loser PropLine rows no longer listed. The NCAAB tab remembers its scroll position. The bid wallet-deploy setting is already live in the engine. Watch resting bids over the next while; I'll look at fill volume next.
